fit_reason: Whole 2020 Kia Soul listed by a private seller on Facebook Marketplace.
findings: Paint on hood, doors and rear hatch shows strong gloss and clear reflections
Unpainted gray rear bumper and lower trim look slightly dull/hazy compared to the paint
Headlights appear clear with no visible yellowing
Interior only visible through glass; nothing to judge
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2020 Kia Soul. The paint already looks glossy in your photos, but the gray rear bumper and lower trim look a little faded next to it. We do mobile pre-sale details, including trim restoration and a wash and wax, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
